ms.text:
any 6 from:
add excess solute, find mass not dissolved
MP1 known / stated volume of water
MP2 add known / stated mass of sodium sulfate (in excess)
MP3 water and solute combined in a suitable named container (test-tube / boiling tube / beaker / flask / polystyrene cup)
MP4 stir / mix / shake
MP5 filter
MP6 dry and weigh residue (ignore washing)
MP7 repeat at (an)other temperature(s)
OR
add solute gradually, stop when no more dissolves
MP1 known / stated volume of water
MP2 add stated measure of sodium sulfate
MP3 water and solute combined in a suitable named container (test-tube / boiling tube / beaker / flask / polystyrene cup)
MP4 stir / mix / shake
MP5 if all dissolved, add more sodium sulfate
MP6 count number of measures / mass added / mass left from initial supply
MP7 repeat at (an)other temperature(s)
OR
add excess solute, find mass that dissolves
MP1 known / stated volume of water
MP2 add excess of sodium sulfate
MP3 water and solute combined in a suitable named container (test-tube / boiling tube / beaker / flask / polystyrene cup)
MP4 stir / mix / shake
MP5 filter
MP6 heat solution to evaporate all water and weigh residue
MP7 repeat at (an)other temperature(s)

OR
fixed mass solute add solvent until all dissolves
MP1 add known volumes / fixed quantities of water gradually to
MP2 known / stated mass of sodium sulfate
MP3 water and solute combined in a suitable named container (test-tube / boiling tube / beaker / flask / polystyrene cup)
MP4 stir / mix / shake
MP5 if not all dissolved, add more water
MP6 measure total volume of water added
MP7 repeat at (an)other temperature(s)
max 6
